description_en: Checks whether the caller and callee numbers are available, primarily to restrict the outbound call frequency of numbers
description_zh: 判断主被叫号码是否可用，主要是限制号码外呼频次
name: CheckNumberAvaliable

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the Cloud Call Center
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The caller number of the Cloud Call Center instance
parameters.name: caller

CalleeAvaliable.description_en: The information about the callee number

Avaliable.description_en: Indicates whether the number is available

Reason.description_en: The reason why the number is unavailable. This parameter is not returned if the number is available. Example values: "Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from all ccc users", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current ccc user", "Outbound Control: Number 18801341234's call times beyonds limit, 3 times/h"
Reason.description_zh: 如果可用不返回，不可用返回原因，例："Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from all ccc users", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current ccc user", "Outbound Control: Number 18801341234's call times beyonds limit, 3 times/h"
Reason.example: Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance

CallerAvaliable.description_en: The information about the caller number

Avaliable.description_en: Indicates whether the number is available

Reason.description_en: The reason why the number is unavailable. This parameter is not returned if the number is available. Example values: "Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from all ccc users", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current ccc user", "Outbound Control: Number 18801341234's call times beyonds limit, 3 times/h"
Reason.description_zh: 如果可用不返回，不可用返回原因，例："Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from all ccc users", "System Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current ccc user", "Outbound Control: Number 18801341234's call times beyonds limit, 3 times/h"
Reason.example: Instance Blacklist: Number 18801341234 can not be called from current instance

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
